structural_rules.description: All prior histories require (race_date, race_id, result_id) < current key (strict).
Same calendar day is allowed only for earlier race_id/result_id; equal date alone is not sufficient.
target_win / target_top3 / target_finish never enter feature formulas
Build pipeline must not read races after observation date for that row
Odds / pools / market prices are excluded from feature sources
field_size from final result cardinality may differ from morning declarations due to scratches — flagged MEDIUM
Permanent horse_id merges/corrections applied today may regroup historical careers retroactively — identity_confidence flag required
